cases.task: Prepare a bounded run for a new Qwen GGUF model on Vulkan0 and Vulkan1.
assertions: Uses isolated Surf CLI research for the exact model and runtime
Stores sanitized raw and curated OKF notes with provenance
Refreshes and queries the project-local QMD collection
Previews and reviews the plan before inference

cases.task: The first context probe times out while the model appears loaded.
assertions: Classifies the timeout as inconclusive rather than OOM
Searches local KB and then authoritative Surf sources
Allows at most one evidence-justified bounded rerun
Records the cause and rerun rationale in sanitized notes
